<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="zh-CN">

<head>

    <meta charset="UTF-8">

    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">

    <title>小学教育测评系统 V4.0 分卷版</title>

    <style>

        :root {

            --bg-primary: #F5F5DC;

            --bg-card: #FFFEF0;

            --text-primary: #2C3E50;

            --text-secondary: #5D6D7E;

            --accent: #D35400;

            --success: #27AE60;

            --success-light: #D5F5E3;

            --error: #C0392B;

            --error-light: #FADBD8;

            --warning: #F39C12;

            --warning-light: #FCF3CF;

            --info: #3498DB;

            --info-light: #EBF5FB;

            --border: #D5C8A0;

            --shadow: rgba(0,0,0,0.08);

            --radius: 16px;

            --font-base: 18px;

            --font-lg: 20px;

            --font-xl: 26px;

        }

        * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

        body {

            background: var(--bg-primary);

            font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;

            font-size: var(--font-base);

            color: var(--text-primary);

            line-height: 1.7;

            min-height: 100vh;

            padding-bottom: 40px;

        }

        .container { max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 16px; }

        h1 { font-size: var(--font-xl); text-align: center; margin: 24px 0 16px; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; }

        h2 { font-size: var(--font-lg); margin: 20px 0 12px; font-weight: 700; }

        .card {

            background: var(--bg-card);

            border-radius: var(--radius);

            padding: 20px;

            margin: 12px 0;

            box-shadow: 0 2px 12px var(--shadow);

            border: 1px solid var(--border);

        }

        .btn {

            display: block; width: 100%; padding: 14px; margin: 10px 0;

            border: 2px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px;

            font-size: var(--font-lg); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;

            transition: all 0.2s; text-align: center; min-height: 56px;

            background: white; color: var(--text-primary);

        }

        .btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

        .btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

        .btn-primary { background: var(--accent); color: white; border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(211,84,0,0.3); }

        .btn-success { background: var(--success); color: white; border-color: var(--success); }

        .btn-warning { background: var(--warning); color: white; border-color: var(--warning); }

        .btn-info { background: var(--info); color: white; border-color: var(--info); }

        .btn-option { text-align: left; padding: 16px 20px 16px 52px; font-weight: 500; position: relative; }

        .btn-option::before {

            content: attr(data-label); position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);

            width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--bg-primary); border: 2px solid var(--border);

            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;

            font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-secondary);

        }

        .btn-option.selected { border-color: var(--accent); background: #FFF5E6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(211,84,0,0.1); }

        .btn-option.selected::before { background: var(--accent); color: white; border-color: var(--accent); }

        .btn-option.correct { border-color: var(--success); background: var(--success-light); }

        .btn-option.correct::before { content: "✓"; background: var(--success); color: white; border-color: var(--success); }

        .btn-option.wrong { border-color: var(--error); background: var(--error-light); }

        .btn-option.wrong::before { content: "✕"; background: var(--error); color: white; border-color: var(--error); }

        .btn-option.disabled { opacity: 0.6; pointer-events: none; }

        .grid-2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }

        .grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }

        .grid-4 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }

        @media (max-width: 480px) { .grid-4 { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } :root { --font-base: 16px; --font-lg: 18px; --font-xl: 22px; } }

        .progress-bar { height: 10px; background: #E8E0C5; border-radius: 5px; overflow: hidden; margin: 16px 0; }

        .progress-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--accent); transition: width 0.4s ease; border-radius: 5px; }

        .explanation {

            background: var(--info-light); border-left: 4px solid var(--info); padding: 16px; margin-top: 16px;

            border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0; display: none;

        }

        .explanation.show { display: block; animation: slideDown 0.3s ease; }

        @keyframes slideDown { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

        .result-ring { width: 160px; height: 160px; margin: 20px auto; position: relative; }

        .ring-bg { fill: none; stroke: #E8E0C5; stroke-width: 12; }

        .ring-fill { fill: none; stroke: var(--accent); stroke-width: 12; stroke-linecap: round; transition: stroke-dashoffset 1s ease; }

        .ring-text { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); text-align: center; }

        .ring-score { font-size: 42px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent); }

        .stat-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-around; margin: 20px 0; text-align: center; }

        .stat-item .num { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; display: block; }

        .stat-item.correct .num { color: var(--success); }

        .stat-item.wrong .num { color: var(--error); }

        .wrong-list { max-height: 400px; overflow-y: auto; margin: 16px 0; }

        .wrong-item { background: white; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; margin: 10px 0; border: 1px solid var(--border); }

        .wrong-item .q-exp { margin-top: 10px; padding: 12px; background: var(--bg-primary); border-radius: 8px; font-size: 16px; }

        .toast {

            position: fixed; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%);

            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.85); color: white; padding: 16px 28px;

            border-radius: 12px; font-size: var(--font-lg); z-index: 1000;

            pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s;

        }

        .toast.show { opacity: 1; }

        .tag { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; margin-left: 8px; vertical-align: middle; }

        .tag-math { background: #EBF5FB; color: #2874A6; }

        .tag-chinese { background: #F5EEF8; color: #8E44AD; }

        .tag-english { background: #E8F8F5; color: #1E8449; }

        .tag-common { background: #FEF9E7; color: #B7950B; }

        .info-box { background: #EBF5FB; border: 1px solid #AED6F1; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; margin: 16px 0; font-size: 15px; color: #1B4F72; }

        .difficulty-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; margin-left: 8px; }

        .diff-easy { background: #D5F5E3; color: #27AE60; }

        .diff-medium { background: #FCF3CF; color: #D4AC0D; }

        .diff-hard { background: #FADBD8; color: #C0392B; }

        .paper-badge { display:inline-block; padding:4px 12px; border-radius:8px; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; margin-left:8px; background:#8E44AD; color:white; }

    </style>

</head>

<body>

    <div id="app"></div>

    <div id="toast" class="toast"></div>

 

<script>

/* ==================== 第零卷：通用工具函数 ==================== */

function shuffleArray(arr) {

    const result = [...arr];

    for(let i = result.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {

        const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));

        [result[i], result[j]] = [result[j], result[i]];

    }

    return result;

}

 

function shuffleOptions(options, correctIndex) {

    const arr = options.map((text, idx) => ({ text, isCorrect: idx === correctIndex }));

    for(let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {

        const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));

        [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];

    }

    return {

        options: arr.map(o => o.text),

        correctIndex: arr.findIndex(o => o.isCorrect)

    };

}

 

function questionFingerprint(q) {

    const core = q.question.replace(/[0-9\s\(\)\[\]\{\}\,\.\?\!\:\;\+\-\*\/\=\<\>\%]+/g, '').substring(0, 20);

    return `${q.type || 'mix'}_${core}`;

}

 

function showToast(msg) {

    const toast = document.getElementById('toast');

    toast.textContent = msg;

    toast.classList.add('show');

    setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 2000);

}

 

/* ==================== 第一卷：全局配置 ==================== */

const CONFIG = {

    VERSION: '4.0',

    STORAGE_PREFIX: 'edu_test_v40_',

    GRADES: [1,2,3,4,5,6],

    TERMS: [1, 2],

    PAPERS: ['A', 'B'],

    SUBJECTS: [

        {id: 'math', name: '数学', tag: 'tag-math'},

        {id: 'chinese', name: '语文', tag: 'tag-chinese'},

        {id: 'english', name: '英语', tag: 'tag-english'},

        {id: 'common', name: '常识', tag: 'tag-common'},

        {id: 'mix', name: '综合', tag: ''}

    ],

    COUNTS: [10, 20, 30, 50]

};

 

function gcd(a,b){while(b){[a,b]=[b,a%b]}return a}

function lcm(a,b){return a*b/gcd(a,b)}

 

/* ==================== 第二卷：数学引擎 ==================== */

const MathEngine = {

    curriculum: {

        '1_1': { topics: ['10以内加减', '20以内不进位', '认识图形', '比较大小', '数的组成', '简单应用', '认识钟表', '找规律'], difficulty: [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1] },

        '1_2': { topics: ['20以内退位减法', '整十数加减', '人民币认识', '找规律', '100以内数', '进位加法', '简单统计'], difficulty: [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 1] },

        '2_1': { topics: ['100以内加减', '表内乘法', '长度单位', '角的认识', '观察物体', '简单推理'], difficulty: [2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2] },

        '2_2': { topics: ['表内除法', '万以内数', '克与千克', '逻辑推理', '有余数除法', '近似数'], difficulty: [2, 2, 1, 3, 3, 2] },

        '3_1': { topics: ['万以内加减', '多位数乘一位数', '分数初步', '时间计算', '周长', '估算'], difficulty: [2, 2, 3, 2, 2, 2] },

        '3_2': { topics: ['除数是一位数', '两位数乘两位数', '小数初步', '面积', '年月日', '平均数'], difficulty: [3, 3, 3, 3, 2, 3] },

        '4_1': { topics: ['大数认识', '公顷平方千米', '三位数乘两位数', '除数是两位数', '角与平行垂直', '条形统计图'], difficulty: [2, 3, 3, 3, 3, 2] },

        '4_2': { topics: ['四则运算', '运算定律', '小数意义', '三角形', '小数加减', '平均数与条形图', '数学广角'], difficulty: [3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 4] },

        '5_1': { topics: ['小数乘法', '位置数对', '小数除法', '可能性', '简易方程', '多边形面积'], difficulty: [3, 2, 3, 3, 4, 4] },

        '5_2': { topics: ['因数倍数', '长方体正方体', '分数意义', '分数加减', '折线统计图', '找次品'], difficulty: [3, 4, 3, 3, 3, 4] },

        '6_1': { topics: ['分数乘法', '位置方向', '分数除法', '比', '圆', '百分数'], difficulty: [4, 2, 4, 4, 4, 4] },

        '6_2': { topics: ['负数', '百分数二', '圆柱圆锥', '比例', '鸽巢原理', '数与代数总复习'], difficulty: [3, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4] }

    },

 

    templates: {

        '1_1': [

            {topic:'10以内加减', diff:1, fn:(s)=>{const a=(s*13)%9+1,b=(s*7)%9+1,c=a+b;return{q:`小明有${a}支铅笔，小红又给他${b}支，现在有几支？`,a:[c,c+1,c-1,c+2],e:`应用题分析：原有${a}支+得到${b}支=现在${c}支。加法应用题要找准"原有"和"增加"的数量。`}}},

            {topic:'10以内加减', diff:1, fn:(s)=>{const a=(s*17)%9+2,b=(s*11)%9+1,c=a-b;return{q:`树上有${a}只鸟，飞走${b}只，还剩几只？`,a:[c,c+1,c-1,a+b],e:`减法应用题：总数${a}只-飞走${b}只=剩下${c}只。注意"飞走"要用减法。`}}},

            {topic:'20以内不进位', diff:1, fn:(s)=>{const a=(s*3)%5+11,b=(s*5)%5+1,c=a+b;return{q:`${a} + ${b} = ?`,a:[c,c+10,c-10,c+1],e:`20以内不进位加法：个位${a%10}+${b}=${a%10+b}，十位${Math.floor(a/10)}不变，结果${c}。注意个位相加不满10，十位直接写1。`}}},

            {topic:'认识图形', diff:1, fn:(s)=>{const shapes=['长方体','正方体','圆柱','球'];const t=shapes[s%4];const others=shapes.filter(x=>x!==t);return{q:`下面哪个是${t}？（认识立体图形）`,a:[t,others[0],others[1],others[2]],e:`立体图形特征：${t}${t==='球'?'——圆圆的，表面光滑，能滚动':t==='圆柱'?'——上下两个圆面，中间是曲面，能滚动':t==='正方体'?'——6个面都是正方形，12条棱长度相等':'——6个面都是长方形（可能有2个正方形面），相对的面相同'}。`}}},

            {topic:'比较大小', diff:1, fn:(s)=>{const a=(s*23)%10+1,b=(s*29)%10+1;return{q:`${a} ○ ${b}，圆圈里填？`,a:[a>b?'>':a<b?'<':'=',a>b?'<':a<b?'>':'≠','≥','≤'],e:`比较大小：${a}${a>b?'大于':a<b?'小于':'等于'}${b}，填"${a>b?'>':a<b?'<':'='}"。开口朝大数，尖尖朝小数。`}}},

            {topic:'数的组成', diff:1, fn:(s)=>{const a=(s*43)%5+1,b=(s*47)%5+1,c=a*10+b;return{q:`${a}个十和${b}个一组成的数是？`,a:[c,a+b,a*b,a*10],e:`数位概念：${a}个十是${a*10}，${b}个一是${b}，合起来是${c}。十位上的数字表示几个十，个位上的数字表示几个一。`}}},

            {topic:'简单应用', diff:1, fn:(s)=>{const items=['苹果','梨','桃','橘子'];const a=(s*53)%5+1,b=(s*59)%5+1,c=a+b;return{q:`盘子里有${a}个${items[s%4]}，又放进${b}个，一共有几个？`,a:[c,a-b,a*b,c+1],e:`加法应用题分析："有${a}个"是原有数量，"放进${b}个"是增加数量，求"一共"用加法：${a}+${b}=${c}个。`}}},

            {topic:'认识钟表', diff:1, fn:(s)=>{const n=(s*71)%12+1;return{q:`${n}时整，时针指向${n>12?n-12:n}，分针指向？`,a:['12','6','3','9'],e:`钟表认识：整点时，分针永远指向12，时针指向几就是几时。${n}时整，分针指向12。`}}},

            {topic:'找规律', diff:1, fn:(s)=>{const start=(s*79)%5+1,d=(s*83)%3+1;const n1=start+d,n2=start+2*d,n3=start+3*d,n4=start+4*d;return{q:`找规律填数：${start}，${n1}，${n2}，___，___`,a:[`${n3}，${n4}`,`${n2}，${n3}`,`${n4}，${n3+d}`,`${start}，${n1}`],e:`找规律：观察相邻两数的差，${n1}-${start}=${d}，${n2}-${n1}=${d}，每次增加${d}，所以后面是${n3}、${n4}。`}}},

            {topic:'10以内加减', diff:1, fn:(s)=>{const n=(s*89)%10+1;return{q:`与${n}相邻的两个数是？`,a:[`${n-1}和${n+1}`,`${n-2}和${n+2}`,`${n}和${n+1}`,`${n-1}和${n}`],e:`相邻数：${n}前面一个数是${n-1}，后面一个数是${n+1}。相邻的两个数相差1。`}}}

        ],

        '1_2': [

            {topic:'20以内退位减法', diff:2, fn:(s)=>{const a=(s*13)%9+11,b=(s*7)%9+2,c=a-b;return{q:`${a} - ${b} = ?（退位减法）`,a:[c,c+10,a+b,c-1],e:`退位减法详解：个位${a%10}减${b}不够减，向十位借1当10，变成${10+a%10}-${b}=${10+a%10-b}，十位1被借走剩0，结果${c}。记住口诀：不够减，向前借，借一当十再减。`}}},

            {topic:'整十数加减', diff:1, fn:(s)=>{const a=((s*17)%9+1)*10,b=((s*11)%9+1)*10,c=a+b;return{q:`${a} + ${b} = ?`,a:[c,c+10,c-10,c+100],e:`整十数加法：${a}是${a/10}个十，${b}是${b/10}个十，${a/10}个十加${b/10}个十=${(a+b)/10}个十，即${c}。整十数相加，十位相加，个位写0。`}}},

            {topic:'人民币认识', diff:1, fn:(s)=>{const coins=[1,2,5,10];const c=coins[s%4];const n=(s*19)%5+2;return{q:`${n}枚${c}角硬币，一共多少角？`,a:[n*c,c+n,c*n+1,c],e:`人民币计算：${n}枚${c}角=${n}×${c}=${n*c}角。1元=10角，${n*c>=10?'='+Math.floor(n*c/10)+'元'+(n*c%10?n*c%10+'角':'')+'，要会进行单位换算':''}。`}}},

            {topic:'找规律', diff:1, fn:(s)=>{const st=(s*23)%10+1,d=(s*29)%3+2;return{q:`找规律：${st}，${st+d}，${st+2*d}，__，__`,a:[`${st+3*d}，${st+4*d}`,`${st+d}，${st+2*d}`,`${st+4*d}，${st+5*d}`,`${st+2*d}，${st+3*d}`],e:`规律分析：观察数列，${st+d}-${st}=${d}，${st+2*d}-${st+d}=${d}，相邻两数差都是${d}（等差数列）。所以接下来是${st+3*d}、${st+4*d}。`}}},

            {topic:'100以内数', diff:1, fn:(s)=>{const n=(s*31)%50+20;return{q:`${n}里面有___个十和___个一`,a:[`${Math.floor(n/10)}，${n%10}`,`${n%10}，${Math.floor(n/10)}`,`${n}，0`,`0，${n}`],e:`数位分析：${n}的十位是${Math.floor(n/10)}，表示${Math.floor(n/10)}个十；个位是${n%10}，表示${n%10}个一。${n}=${Math.floor(n/10)}×10+${n%10}×1。`}}},

            {topic:'进位加法', diff:2, fn:(s)=>{const a=(s*37)%20+10,b=(s*41)%10+1,c=a+b;return{q:`${a} + ${b} = ?（进位加法）`,a:[c,c-10,c+10,c-1],e:`进位加法详解：个位${a%10}+${b}=${a%10+b}${a%10+b>=10?'，满十要向十位进1':''}。十位${Math.floor(a/10)}${a%10+b>=10?'+1（进位）':''}=${Math.floor(c/10)}，结果${c}。`}}},

            {topic:'简单统计', diff:1, fn:(s)=>{const colors=['红','黄','蓝','绿'];const counts=[3,4,5,6];const idx=s%4;const total=counts.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);return{q:`统计：${colors.map((c,i)=>c+counts[i]+'个').join('，')}，一共几个？`,a:[total,total-1,total+1,counts[idx]],e:`加法统计：${counts.join('+')}=${total}个。统计总数要把各部分数量相加。`}}},

            {topic:'人民币认识', diff:1, fn:(s)=>{const n=(s*43)%5+1;return{q:`1张5元+${n}张1元=？元`,a:[5+n,5*n,5-n,5],e:`人民币计算：1张5元是5元，${n}张1元是${n}元，一共5+${n}=${5+n}元。计算时单位统一（都是元），直接相加。`}}},

    generate(grade, term, count, version='A') {

        const key = `${grade}_${term}`;

        const templates = this.templates[key];

        if(!templates) return [];

        

        const versionOffset = version === 'B' ? 10000 : 0;

        const usedFingerprints = new Set();

        const results = [];

        const allCandidates = [];

        

        for(let seed=0; seed<templates.length*5; seed++) {

            const tmpl = templates[seed % templates.length];

            const raw = tmpl.fn(seed + grade*100 + term*10 + versionOffset);

            const q = {

                id: `M${grade}${term}_${version}_${seed}`,

                type: 'math',

                grade, term,

                topic: tmpl.topic,

                difficulty: tmpl.diff,

                question: raw.q,

                options: raw.a,

                explanation: raw.e,

                correctIndex: 0

            };

            allCandidates.push(q);

        }

        

        const shuffled = shuffleArray(allCandidates);

        

        for(const q of shuffled) {

            if(results.length >= count) break;

            const fp = questionFingerprint(q);

            if(!usedFingerprints.has(fp)) {

                usedFingerprints.add(fp);

                const uniqueOpts = [...new Set(q.options)];

                while(uniqueOpts.length < 4) {

                    const fb = (uniqueOpts.length + 1) * (grade + term);

                    if(!uniqueOpts.includes(String(fb))) uniqueOpts.push(String(fb));

                }

                const shuffledOpts = shuffleOptions(uniqueOpts.slice(0,4), 0);

                q.options = shuffledOpts.options;

                q.correctIndex = shuffledOpts.correctIndex;

                results.push(q);

            }

        }

        

        return results;

    }

};

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"吃水不忘挖井人"中，挖井人是谁？',a:'毛主席',opts:['毛主席','周总理','朱德','刘少奇'],e:'江西沙洲坝的井是毛主席带领战士和乡亲们挖的。"吃水不忘挖井人"比喻不忘本，感恩。'},

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"我多想去看看"中，"我"想去看什么？',a:'天安门',opts:['天安门','长城','故宫','西湖'],e:'课文表达了一个孩子对北京天安门的向往。"遥远"的北京，"壮观"的升旗仪式，体现了孩子对祖国首都的热爱。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"小公鸡和小鸭子"中，小鸭子会什么？',a:'游泳',opts:['游泳','捉虫','跑步','飞'],e:'小鸭子会游泳，小公鸡会捉虫。故事告诉我们：每个人都有自己的长处和短处，要互相帮助。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"树和喜鹊"中，树很快乐，喜鹊呢？',a:'也很快乐',opts:['也很快乐','很伤心','很孤单','很害怕'],e:'课文通过"树"和"喜鹊"的变化，告诉我们：有朋友才快乐。"孤单"的反义词是"快乐"。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"静夜思"的作者是谁？',a:'李白',opts:['李白','杜甫','王维','白居易'],e:'李白《静夜思》：床前明月光，疑是地上霜。举头望明月，低头思故乡。表达了游子的思乡之情。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"夜色"中，"我"原来怕什么？',a:'黑',opts:['黑','白','红','绿'],e:'课文写了一个孩子从怕黑到不怕黑的过程。爸爸晚上拉"我"去散步，"我"发现夜晚也很美好。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"端午粽"中，粽子用什么包的？',a:'箬竹叶',opts:['箬竹叶','荷叶','芭蕉叶','梧桐叶'],e:'粽子用青青的箬竹叶包的，里面裹着白白的糯米，中间有一颗红红的枣。课文从色、香、味描写粽子。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"彩虹"中，"我"想把彩虹当什么？',a:'桥',opts:['桥','路','船','伞'],e:'雨停了，天上有一座美丽的桥，那就是彩虹。"我"想把彩虹当桥，帮爸爸妈妈做事，体现了孩子的天真和孝顺。'}

            ]

        },

        '2_1': {

            units: ['课文一','课文二','课文三','课文四','课文五'],

            items: [

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"小蝌蚪找妈妈"中，小蝌蚪的妈妈是？',a:'青蛙',opts:['青蛙','鲤鱼','乌龟','鸭子'],e:'小蝌蚪先长出后腿，再长出前腿，尾巴变短，最后变成青蛙。这是青蛙的生长过程（变态发育）。'},

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"我是什么"中，"我"是什么？',a:'水',opts:['水','火','风','云'],e:'课文用第一人称写水的变化：云、雨、雪、冰雹。水在自然界循环，形态多变。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"曹冲称象"中，曹冲用什么代替大象？',a:'石头',opts:['石头','沙子','水','粮食'],e:'曹冲用石头代替大象的重量，利用船的吃水深度相同，这是"等量代换"的思想，体现了曹冲的聪明。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"玲玲的画"中，玲玲把脏的地方画成了什么？',a:'小花狗',opts:['小花狗','小鸟','小猫','小兔'],e:'爸爸启发玲玲：好多事情并不像我们想象的那么糟，只要肯动脑筋，坏事往往能变成好事。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"登鹳雀楼"的作者是谁？',a:'王之涣',opts:['王之涣','李白','杜甫','王维'],e:'王之涣《登鹳雀楼》：白日依山尽，黄河入海流。欲穷千里目，更上一层楼。后两句是千古名句，比喻要站得高看得远。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"望庐山瀑布"的作者是谁？',a:'李白',opts:['李白','杜甫','白居易','苏轼'],e:'李白《望庐山瀑布》：日照香炉生紫烟，遥看瀑布挂前川。飞流直下三千尺，疑是银河落九天。"三千尺"是夸张手法。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"黄山奇石"中，"仙人指路"像什么？',a:'一位仙人站在山峰上',opts:['一位仙人站在山峰上','一只猴子','一只公鸡','一块巨石'],e:'课文用比喻和想象描写黄山奇石。"仙人指路"像一位仙人站在高高的山峰上，伸着手臂指向前方。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"日月潭"是我国哪个省的？',a:'台湾',opts:['台湾','福建','浙江','广东'],e:'日月潭是我国台湾省最大的一个湖，景色优美。"日月潭"名字来源于湖中小岛把湖分成日潭和月潭。'},

                {unit:'课文五',q:'"坐井观天"告诉我们什么道理？',a:'眼界要开阔',opts:['眼界要开阔','天很小','井很深','青蛙很傻'],e:'寓言告诉我们：看问题、认识事物，站得要高，看得要全面。不能局限于自己的小圈子。'},

                {unit:'课文五',q:'"寒号鸟"中，寒号鸟为什么冻死？',a:'懒惰不做窝',opts:['懒惰不做窝','没有食物','天气太冷','被人打死'],e:'寒号鸟得过且过，"明天再做窝"，结果冬天冻死了。故事告诉我们：不能懒惰，要勤劳，要未雨绸缪。'}

            ]

        },

        '2_2': {

            units: ['课文一','课文二','课文三','课文四','课文五'],

            items: [

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"村居"的作者是谁？',a:'高鼎',opts:['高鼎','李白','杜甫','王维'],e:'高鼎《村居》：草长莺飞二月天，拂堤杨柳醉春烟。儿童散学归来早，忙趁东风放纸鸢。描绘了春天乡村的美好景象。'},

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"咏柳"的作者是谁？',a:'贺知章',opts:['贺知章','李白','杜甫','白居易'],e:'贺知章《咏柳》：碧玉妆成一树高，万条垂下绿丝绦。不知细叶谁裁出，二月春风似剪刀。把春风比作剪刀，非常形象。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"雷锋叔叔，你在哪里"中，雷锋帮助了谁？',a:'迷路的孩子',opts:['迷路的孩子','老人','病人','学生'],e:'雷锋抱着迷路的孩子，冒着蒙蒙的细雨。雷锋是解放军战士，乐于助人，是学习的榜样。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"千人糕"中，"千人糕"是什么？',a:'米糕',opts:['米糕','年糕','蛋糕','雪糕'],e:'千人糕就是平常吃的米糕，经过很多很多人的劳动才做成。告诉我们：要珍惜劳动成果，尊重劳动者。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"神州谣"中，"黄河奔"，"长江"怎样？',a:'涌',opts:['涌','流','奔','跑'],e:'课文：黄河奔，长江涌，长城长，珠峰耸。用动词表现祖国山河的壮美。"涌"写出长江波涛汹涌的气势。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"传统节日"中，元宵节要做什么？',a:'看花灯',opts:['看花灯','吃月饼','赛龙舟','登高'],e:'课文：元宵节，看花灯，大街小巷人如潮。春节贴窗花放鞭炮，端午赛龙舟吃粽子，中秋吃月饼赏月。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"彩色的梦"中，"我"的彩色铅笔是什么？',a:'大森林的精灵',opts:['大森林的精灵','小精灵','魔法师','画家'],e:'课文用拟人手法，把彩色铅笔比作大森林的精灵。"脚尖滑过的地方"指铅笔画画。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"枫树上的喜鹊"中，"我"学会了什么？',a:'喜鹊的语言',opts:['喜鹊的语言','唱歌','跳舞','画画'],e:'"我"懂得喜鹊的语言，像听懂了似的。课文表现了孩子对大自然的热爱和丰富的想象力。'},

                {unit:'课文五',q:'"亡羊补牢"告诉我们什么？',a:'及时补救',opts:['及时补救','不用补','已经晚了','放弃'],e:'亡羊补牢，为时不晚。出了问题后及时补救，可以防止继续受损失。与"揠苗助长"形成对比。'},

                {unit:'课文五',q:'"画杨桃"中，老师教育大家什么？',a:'从不同角度看问题',opts:['从不同角度看问题','要认真画画','要听老师话','不要画杨桃'],e:'老师的话：当我们看见别人把杨桃画成五角星的时候，不要忙着发笑，要看看人家是从什么角度看的。'}

            ]

        },

        '3_1': {

            units: ['课文一','课文二','课文三','课文四','课文五'],

            items: [

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"大青树下的小学"中，学校有什么不同？',a:'不同民族',opts:['不同民族','不同年级','不同性别','不同年龄'],e:'课文描写了一所边疆小学，有汉族、傣族、景颇族、阿昌族、德昂族等不同民族的学生，体现了民族团结。'},

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"花的学校"作者是谁？',a:'泰戈尔',opts:['泰戈尔','鲁迅','老舍','冰心'],e:'《花的学校》选自泰戈尔的《新月集》。泰戈尔是印度诗人，曾获诺贝尔文学奖。"雷云拍着大手"是拟人手法。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"铺满金色巴掌的水泥道"中，"金色巴掌"是什么？',a:'梧桐叶',opts:['梧桐叶','银杏叶','枫叶','荷叶'],e:'法国梧桐树的落叶像金色的小巴掌。"金色"写出了秋叶的颜色，"巴掌"写出了叶子的形状，比喻生动形象。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"秋天的雨"中，秋天的雨有什么？',a:'一盒五彩缤纷的颜料',opts:['一盒五彩缤纷的颜料','一把钥匙','一封信','一首歌'],e:'课文把秋天的雨比作颜料盒、钥匙、喇叭等，用比喻和拟人手法写秋雨带来的变化。"五彩缤纷"写出了秋天的色彩丰富。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"去年的树"中，树被怎么了？',a:'砍了',opts:['砍了','烧了','卖了','移植了'],e:'树被砍了做成火柴，鸟儿找了好久。这是一个感人的故事，歌颂了鸟儿对树的真挚友情，也呼吁保护环境。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"在牛肚子里旅行"中，青头和红头是什么？',a:'蟋蟀',opts:['蟋蟀','蚂蚁','蚂蚱','蝗虫'],e:'青头和红头是一对非常要好的蟋蟀朋友。课文科普了牛反刍的知识：牛有四个胃，会反刍。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"望天门山"的作者是谁？',a:'李白',opts:['李白','杜甫','王维','苏轼'],e:'李白《望天门山》：天门中断楚江开，碧水东流至此回。两岸青山相对出，孤帆一片日边来。写出了长江冲破天门山的壮阔气势。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"富饶的西沙群岛"中，西沙群岛有什么特点？',a:'风景优美，物产丰富',opts:['风景优美，物产丰富','只有沙子','只有海水','只有鱼'],e:'课文从海水、海底、海滩、海岛四方面写西沙群岛，展现了"风景优美、物产丰富"的特点，表达了对祖国海疆的热爱。'},

                {unit:'课文五',q:'"司马光"中，司马光用什么砸缸？',a:'石头',opts:['石头','手','脚','棍子'],e:'司马光拿起一块石头，使劲砸那口缸。司马光遇事冷静、机智勇敢，和其他孩子的慌乱形成对比。'},

                {unit:'课文五',q:'"掌声"中，掌声给了英子什么？',a:'鼓励',opts:['鼓励','嘲笑','同情','冷漠'],e:'英子以前很自卑，同学们的掌声给了她鼓励和信心，让她勇敢地面对生活。掌声代表着尊重、鼓励和关爱。'}

            ]

        },

        '3_2': {

            units: ['课文一','课文二','课文三','课文四','课文五'],

            items: [

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"元日"的作者是谁？',a:'王安石',opts:['王安石','李白','杜甫','苏轼'],e:'王安石《元日》：爆竹声中一岁除，春风送暖入屠苏。千门万户曈曈日，总把新桃换旧符。描写了春节除旧迎新的景象。'},

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"清明"的作者是谁？',a:'杜牧',opts:['杜牧','李白','杜甫','王维'],e:'杜牧《清明》：清明时节雨纷纷，路上行人欲断魂。借问酒家何处有？牧童遥指杏花村。写出了清明时节的凄迷氛围。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"纸的发明"中，谁改进了造纸术？',a:'蔡伦',opts:['蔡伦','毕昇','张衡','李时珍'],e:'东汉蔡伦改进了造纸术，用树皮、麻头、破布、旧渔网等原料，造出了便宜好用的纸。造纸术是中国四大发明之一。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"赵州桥"的设计者是谁？',a:'李春',opts:['李春','鲁班','张衡','李时珍'],e:'赵州桥由隋朝工匠李春设计建造，距今1400多年，是世界上现存最古老的石拱桥。体现了古代劳动人民的智慧。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"花钟"中，不同的花有什么不同？',a:'开放时间不同',opts:['开放时间不同','颜色不同','形状不同','香味不同'],e:'课文说明不同的植物开花时间不同，与温度、湿度、光照和昆虫活动时间有关。这是科学小品文，兼具科学性和文学性。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"蜜蜂"的作者法布尔是什么学家？',a:'法国昆虫学家',opts:['法国昆虫学家','英国生物学家','德国物理学家','美国化学家'],e:'法布尔是法国著名昆虫学家，著有《昆虫记》。课文写了他做实验验证蜜蜂有辨认方向的能力，体现了严谨的科学态度。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"宇宙的另一边"中，"我"想象宇宙另一边有什么？',a:'有个一样的我',opts:['有个一样的我','有外星人','有神仙','有怪兽'],e:'课文充满想象力：在宇宙的另一边，有个一样的我，正在做着相反的事情。乘法是这样的……体现了儿童丰富的想象力。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"我变成了一棵树"中，"我"变成了什么？',a:'一棵树',opts:['一棵树','一只鸟','一朵花','一片云'],e:'"我"变成了一棵长满各种形状鸟窝的树，妈妈带着好吃的来了。课文表现了母子情深和儿童的天真想象。'},

                {unit:'课文五',q:'"慢性子裁缝和急性子顾客"中，裁缝有什么特点？',a:'很慢',opts:['很慢','很快','一般','不急'],e:'裁缝是个慢性子，顾客是个急性子。故事通过性格对比，产生了幽默效果，告诉我们：做事不能急躁，也不能太慢。'},

                {unit:'课文五',q:'"漏"中，"漏"到底是什么？',a:'屋顶漏雨',opts:['屋顶漏雨','怪物','小偷','老虎'],e:'老虎和贼都以为"漏"是厉害的怪物，其实"漏"是屋顶漏雨。故事充满民间故事的幽默和巧合，告诉我们：做贼心虚。'}

            ]

        },

        '4_1': {

            units: ['课文一','课文二','课文三','课文四','课文五'],

            items: [

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"观潮"中，钱塘江大潮什么时候最壮观？',a:'农历八月十八',opts:['农历八月十八','正月十五','五月初五','九月初九'],e:'农历八月十八是一年一度的观潮日。钱塘江大潮是世界奇观，由天体引力和地球自转离心力造成，加上杭州湾喇叭口地形，形成壮观潮涌。'},

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"走月亮"是什么意思？',a:'在月光下散步',opts:['在月光下散步','看月亮','追月亮','画月亮'],e:'"走月亮"是吴地传统民俗，指在月光下散步。课文描写了"我"和阿妈在月光下散步的温馨情景，充满诗情画意。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"一个豆荚里的五粒豆"作者是谁？',a:'安徒生',opts:['安徒生','格林','伊索','克雷洛夫'],e:'安徒生童话。最后一粒豆落在窗台上，发芽开花，给生病的小女孩带来了希望。故事告诉我们：生命的价值在于给别人带来希望和快乐。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"蝙蝠和雷达"中，雷达模仿了什么？',a:'蝙蝠',opts:['蝙蝠','鸟儿','鱼儿','青蛙'],e:'科学家模仿蝙蝠探路的方法（超声波），给飞机装上了雷达。这是仿生学的例子，从生物身上得到启示发明创造。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"暮江吟"的作者是谁？',a:'白居易',opts:['白居易','李白','杜甫','王维'],e:'白居易《暮江吟》：一道残阳铺水中，半江瑟瑟半江红。可怜九月初三夜，露似真珠月似弓。描绘了秋江傍晚到夜晚的美景。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"题西林壁"的作者是谁？',a:'苏轼',opts:['苏轼','李白','杜甫','王维'],e:'苏轼《题西林壁》：不识庐山真面目，只缘身在此山中。告诉我们"当局者迷，旁观者清"的道理，也说明了观察角度的重要性。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"爬山虎的脚"中，爬山虎的脚是什么？',a:'茎上的细丝',opts:['茎上的细丝','叶子','根','花'],e:'爬山虎茎上长叶柄的地方，反面伸出枝状的六七根细丝，这些细丝就是爬山虎的脚。课文观察细致，描写准确，是状物散文的典范。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"蟋蟀的住宅"中，蟋蟀的住宅是谁挖掘的？',a:'蟋蟀自己',opts:['蟋蟀自己','天生的','别的昆虫','人类'],e:'蟋蟀不肯随遇而安，自己慎重选择住址，挖掘住宅。法布尔把蟋蟀的洞穴比作"住宅"，用拟人手法表达了对小生命的尊重。'},

                {unit:'课文五',q:'"普罗米修斯"中，普罗米修斯做了什么？',a:'盗火给人类',opts:['盗火给人类','创造了人类','毁灭了人类','统治了人类'],e:'普罗米修斯为人类盗取天火，遭受宙斯的惩罚。这是古希腊神话，歌颂了普罗米修斯为民造福、不惜牺牲的精神。'},

                {unit:'课文五',q:'"女娲补天"中，女娲用什么补天？',a:'五彩石',opts:['五彩石','泥土','石头','金子'],e:'女娲炼五色石补苍天，斩龟足撑四极。这是中国上古神话，表现了女娲勇敢善良、不怕危险、甘于奉献的精神。'}

            ]

        },

        '4_2': {

            units: ['课文一','课文二','课文三','课文四','课文五'],

            items: [

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"四时田园杂兴"的作者是谁？',a:'范成大',opts:['范成大','杨万里','陆游','辛弃疾'],e:'范成大《四时田园杂兴》：昼出耘田夜绩麻，村庄儿女各当家。描写了农村夏日紧张劳动的气氛，表现了农民的勤劳。'},

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"宿新市徐公店"的作者是谁？',a:'杨万里',opts:['杨万里','范成大','陆游','辛弃疾'],e:'杨万里《宿新市徐公店》：篱落疏疏一径深，树头新绿未成阴。儿童急走追黄蝶，飞入菜花无处寻。写出了乡村春日的生机和童趣。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"琥珀"是什么？',a:'松脂化石',opts:['松脂化石','石头','宝石','金属'],e:'琥珀是远古时代的松脂化石，里面可能包着昆虫。科学家通过琥珀可以推测远古时代生物和环境的情况。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"飞向蓝天的恐龙"中，恐龙变成了什么？',a:'鸟类',opts:['鸟类','灭绝了','鱼','哺乳动物'],e:'恐龙的一支经过漫长的演化，最终变成了凌空翱翔的鸟儿。这是科学发现，体现了科学探索的过程。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"短诗三首"中"繁星"的作者是谁？',a:'冰心',opts:['冰心','巴金','老舍','鲁迅'],e:'冰心《繁星》：这些事——是永不漫灭的回忆：月明的园中，藤萝的叶下，母亲的膝上。表达了对母亲的依恋和母爱的温馨。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"绿"的作者是谁？',a:'艾青',opts:['艾青','冰心','巴金','老舍'],e:'艾青《绿》：好像绿色的墨水瓶倒翻了，到处是绿的……用夸张和想象描写了春天到处是绿色的景象。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"猫"的作者是谁？',a:'老舍',opts:['老舍','鲁迅','巴金','冰心'],e:'老舍《猫》：猫的性格实在有些古怪。老舍用平实而风趣的语言，写出了猫的古怪性格和淘气可爱，表达了对猫的喜爱。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"母鸡"的作者是谁？',a:'老舍',opts:['老舍','鲁迅','巴金','冰心'],e:'老舍《母鸡》：我一向讨厌母鸡。后来不敢再讨厌了，因为母鸡负责、慈爱、勇敢、辛苦。这是欲扬先抑的写法。'},

                {unit:'课文五',q:'"海上日出"的作者是谁？',a:'巴金',opts:['巴金','老舍','鲁迅','冰心'],e:'巴金《海上日出》：为了看日出，我常常早起。按日出前、日出时、日出后的顺序，描写了海上日出的壮观景象。'},

                {unit:'课文五',q:'"记金华的双龙洞"的作者是谁？',a:'叶圣陶',opts:['叶圣陶','巴金','老舍','鲁迅'],e:'叶圣陶《记金华的双龙洞》：4月14日，我在浙江金华，游北山的双龙洞。按游览顺序（路上-洞口-外洞-孔隙-内洞-出洞）记叙。'}

            ]

        },

        '5_1': {

            units: ['课文一','课文二','课文三','课文四','课文五'],

            items: [

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"白鹭"的作者是谁？',a:'郭沫若',opts:['郭沫若','老舍','巴金','鲁迅'],e:'郭沫若《白鹭》：白鹭是一首精巧的诗。用诗一样的语言，赞美了白鹭的平凡而美好。'},

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"落花生"的作者是谁？',a:'许地山',opts:['许地山','老舍','巴金','鲁迅'],e:'许地山《落花生》：人要做有用的人，不要做只讲体面而对别人没有好处的人。借物喻人，由花生的特点说明做人的道理。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"将相和"中，"将"指谁？',a:'廉颇',opts:['廉颇','蔺相如','王翦','白起'],e:'"将"指大将军廉颇，"相"指上卿蔺相如。"将相和"讲了完璧归赵、渑池之会、负荆请罪三个故事，表现了两人以国家利益为重的品质。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"什么比猎豹的速度更快"中，速度最快的是什么？',a:'光',opts:['光','猎豹','火箭','流星体'],e:'课文从人、鸵鸟、猎豹、游隼、飞机、火箭、流星体到光，光速最快（约30万千米/秒）。这是科普说明文，用比较和列数字的方法说明。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"示儿"的作者是谁？',a:'陆游',opts:['陆游','李白','杜甫','苏轼'],e:'陆游《示儿》：死去元知万事空，但悲不见九州同。王师北定中原日，家祭无忘告乃翁。陆游临终前仍心系国家统一，感人至深。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"少年中国说"的作者是谁？',a:'梁启超',opts:['梁启超','康有为','孙中山','鲁迅'],e:'梁启超《少年中国说》：少年智则国智，少年富则国富，少年强则国强。把少年和国家命运联系在一起，激励少年奋发图强。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"太阳"中，太阳离我们多远？',a:'约一亿五千万千米',opts:['约一亿五千万千米','约一千万千米','约十亿千米','约一百万千米'],e:'课文用列数字、举例子、作比较等说明方法，介绍了太阳远、大、热的特点，以及太阳与人类的密切关系。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"松鼠"有什么特点？',a:'乖巧驯良',opts:['乖巧驯良','凶猛','懒惰','笨拙'],e:'布封《松鼠》：松鼠是一种漂亮的小动物，乖巧，驯良，很讨人喜欢。课文从外形、活动、搭窝、生育等方面介绍了松鼠。'},

                {unit:'课文五',q:'"慈母情深"中，母亲在哪里工作？',a:'低矮的厂房',opts:['低矮的厂房','写字楼','学校','医院'],e:'母亲在低矮、潮湿、闷热的厂房里辛苦工作，挣钱供"我"读书。课文表现了母爱的伟大和"我"对母亲的感激。'},

                {unit:'课文五',q:'"精彩极了和糟糕透了"中，两种评价代表什么？',a:'鼓励和严格要求',opts:['鼓励和严格要求','表扬和批评','爱和恨','对和错'],e:'母亲说"精彩极了"是鼓励，父亲说"糟糕透了"是严格要求。两种评价缺一不可，都是爱的表现。'}

            ]

        },

        '5_2': {

            units: ['课文一','课文二','课文三','课文四','课文五'],

            items: [

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"四时田园杂兴"的作者是谁？',a:'范成大',opts:['范成大','杨万里','陆游','辛弃疾'],e:'范成大《四时田园杂兴》：昼出耘田夜绩麻，村庄儿女各当家。童孙未解供耕织，也傍桑阴学种瓜。写出了农村儿童的天真情趣。'},

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"稚子弄冰"的作者是谁？',a:'杨万里',opts:['杨万里','范成大','陆游','辛弃疾'],e:'杨万里《稚子弄冰》：稚子金盆脱晓冰，彩丝穿取当银钲。敲成玉磬穿林响，忽作玻璃碎地声。写出了儿童玩冰的乐趣。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"草船借箭"中，诸葛亮有什么特点？',a:'神机妙算',opts:['神机妙算','鲁莽','愚蠢','胆小'],e:'诸葛亮神机妙算，利用大雾和曹操多疑的性格，借得十万支箭。表现了诸葛亮的智慧和胆识。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"景阳冈"中，武松有什么特点？',a:'勇猛',opts:['勇猛','懦弱','狡猾','懒惰'],e:'武松勇猛过人，赤手空拳打死老虎。"武松打虎"是《水浒传》中的经典情节，表现了武松的英雄气概。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"从军行"的作者是谁？',a:'王昌龄',opts:['王昌龄','李白','杜甫','王维'],e:'王昌龄《从军行》：青海长云暗雪山，孤城遥望玉门关。黄沙百战穿金甲，不破楼兰终不还。表现了将士们保卫祖国的决心。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"青山处处埋忠骨"中，"忠骨"指谁？',a:'毛岸英',opts:['毛岸英','岳飞','关羽','文天祥'],e:'毛岸英在抗美援朝中牺牲，毛主席忍痛同意葬在朝鲜。"青山处处埋忠骨，何须马革裹尸还"表现了伟人的胸怀。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"人物描写一组"中，"摔跤"写的是谁？',a:'小嘎子',opts:['小嘎子','祥子','严监生','刷子李'],e:'《摔跤》描写了小嘎子和胖墩儿比赛摔跤的情景，通过动作描写表现了小嘎子机灵、争强好胜的性格。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"刷子李"有什么规矩？',a:'身上没白点',opts:['身上没白点','一天只刷一家','只刷外墙','不收钱'],e:'刷子李有个规矩：刷墙时穿一身黑，只要身上有白点，白刷不要钱。表现了他技艺高超和自信。'},

                {unit:'课文五',q:'"自相矛盾"中，"矛盾"现在比喻什么？',a:'言行不一致',opts:['言行不一致','武器','工具','食物'],e:'"矛盾"现在比喻言行不一致或相互抵触。这个成语出自《韩非子》，告诉我们说话做事要前后一致。'},

                {unit:'课文五',q:'"田忌赛马"中，孙膑用什么方法取胜？',a:'调换马出场顺序',opts:['调换马出场顺序','换了好马','贿赂对手','作弊'],e:'孙膑帮田忌调换马的出场顺序（下对上，中对下，上对中），反败为胜。这是策略问题，体现了智慧。'}

            ]

        },

        '6_1': {

            units: ['课文一','课文二','课文三','课文四','课文五'],

            items: [

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"草原"的作者是谁？',a:'老舍',opts:['老舍','巴金','鲁迅','冰心'],e:'老舍《草原》：这次，我看到了草原。按事情发展顺序，写了草原美景、迎客、联欢、话别，表现了蒙汉两族人民的深情厚谊。'},

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"丁香结"的作者是谁？',a:'宗璞',opts:['宗璞','冰心','巴金','老舍'],e:'宗璞《丁香结》：丁香空结雨中愁。由丁香花联想到"丁香结"，进而想到人生中的"结"（困难和不顺心），表达了豁达的人生态度。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"七律·长征"的作者是谁？',a:'毛泽东',opts:['毛泽东','朱德','周恩来','陈毅'],e:'毛泽东《七律·长征》：红军不怕远征难，万水千山只等闲。概括了红军长征的艰难历程，歌颂了红军不怕困难的精神。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"狼牙山五壮士"中，五壮士最后怎样？',a:'跳崖',opts:['跳崖','投降','逃跑','隐藏'],e:'五壮士把敌人引上绝路，打完最后一颗子弹，英勇跳崖。表现了革命战士宁死不屈的英雄气概。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"竹节人"中，竹节人是什么？',a:'玩具',opts:['玩具','食物','工具','武器'],e:'竹节人是用竹子做的玩具。课文回忆了童年做竹节人、玩竹节人的乐趣，表达了对童年生活的怀念。'},

                {unit:'课文三',q:'"宇宙生命之谜"中，目前发现外星生命了吗？',a:'未发现',opts:['未发现','发现了','确定有','确定没有'],e:'课文是科普说明文，介绍了科学家探索地球之外是否有生命的过程。至今，地球之外是否有生命存在，仍然是一个谜。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"桥"中，老支书有什么品质？',a:'舍己为人',opts:['舍己为人','自私','胆小','贪婪'],e:'老支书在洪水中舍己为人，牺牲了自己和儿子。课文以"桥"为题，既指实际的桥，也指老支书这座"生命桥"。'},

                {unit:'课文四',q:'"穷人"中，桑娜和渔夫有什么品质？',a:'善良',opts:['善良','懒惰','富有','冷漠'],e:'桑娜和渔夫虽然贫穷，但善良，主动收养了邻居西蒙的两个孤儿。表现了穷人宁可自己受苦也要帮助别人的高尚品质。'},

                {unit:'课文五',q:'"伯牙鼓琴"中，钟子期有什么特点？',a:'善听',opts:['善听','善鼓琴','善画','善写'],e:'伯牙善鼓琴，钟子期善听。"善听"指能听懂琴声中的意境。钟子期死后，伯牙破琴绝弦，终身不复鼓琴。表现了知音难觅。'},

                {unit:'课文五',q:'"月光曲"中，贝多芬为什么弹琴？',a:'被盲姑娘感动',opts:['被盲姑娘感动','为自己','为国王','为贵族'],e:'贝多芬被盲姑娘对音乐的热爱感动，为她弹奏并创作了《月光曲》。表现了贝多芬对穷苦人民的同情和对音乐的热爱。'}

            ]

        },

        '6_2': {

            units: ['课文一','课文二','课文三','课文四','课文五'],

            items: [

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"北京的春节"的作者是谁？',a:'老舍',opts:['老舍','巴金','鲁迅','冰心'],e:'老舍《北京的春节》：按照北京的老规矩，过农历的新年（春节），差不多在腊月的初旬就开头了。按时间顺序写了春节的习俗。'},

                {unit:'课文一',q:'"腊八粥"的作者是谁？',a:'沈从文',opts:['沈从文','老舍','巴金','鲁迅'],e:'沈从文《腊八粥》：初学喊爸爸的小孩子……提到腊八粥，谁不是嘴里就立时生一种甜甜的腻腻的感觉呢。用排比和反问写出了人们对腊八粥的喜爱。'},

                {unit:'课文二',q:'"藏戏"中，藏戏有什么特点？',a:'戴着面具演出',opts:['戴着面具演出','不戴面具','只唱歌','只跳舞'],e:'藏戏的特点是戴着面具演出，演出时没有舞台，一部戏可以演出三五天。这是藏族文化的瑰宝。'},

    generate(grade, term, count, version='A') {

        const key = `${grade}_${term}`;

        const data = this.data[key];

        if(!data) return [];

        

        const usedFingerprints = new Set();

        const results = [];

        const byUnit = {};

        data.items.forEach(item => {

            if(!byUnit[item.unit]) byUnit[item.unit] = [];

            byUnit[item.unit].push(item);

        });

        

        const units = Object.keys(byUnit);

        let unitIdx = 0;

        const versionOffset = version === 'B' ? 5 : 0;

        

        while(results.length < count) {

            const unit = units[(unitIdx + versionOffset) % units.length];

            const pool = byUnit[unit];

            const item = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];

            

            const q = {

                id: `C${grade}${term}_${version}_${results.length}`,

                type: 'chinese',

                grade, term,

                unit: item.unit,

                question: item.q,

                options: item.opts,

                explanation: item.e,

                correctIndex: 0

            };

            

            const fp = questionFingerprint(q);

            if(!usedFingerprints.has(fp)) {

                usedFingerprints.add(fp);

                const shuffled = shuffleOptions(q.options, 0);

                q.options = shuffled.options;

                q.correctIndex = shuffled.correctIndex;

                results.push(q);

            }

            

            unitIdx++;

            if(unitIdx > count * 3) break;

        }

        

        while(results.length < count) {

            const fallback = data.items[(results.length + versionOffset) % data.items.length];

            const shuffled = shuffleOptions(fallback.opts, 0);

            results.push({

                id: `C${grade}${term}_${version}_${results.length}`,

                type: 'chinese',

                grade, term,

                unit: fallback.unit,

                question: fallback.q,

                options: shuffled.options,

                correctIndex: shuffled.correctIndex,

                explanation: fallback.e

            });

        }

        

        return results.slice(0, count);

    }

};

    generate(grade, term, count, version='A') {

        const key = `${grade}_${term}`;

        const vocab = this.vocabulary[key];

        const grammar = this.grammarTemplates[key];

        const results = [];

        const used = new Set();

        const versionOffset = version === 'B' ? 7 : 0;

        

        let vocabList = [], trans = {};

        if(vocab) {

            vocabList = vocab.words;

            trans = vocab.trans;

        } else {

            for(let g=grade; g>=1; g--) {

                const k = `${g}_${term}`;

                if(this.vocabulary[k]) {

                    vocabList = this.vocabulary[k].words;

                    trans = this.vocabulary[k].trans;

                    break;

                }

            }

        }

        

        const vocabCount = Math.ceil(count * 0.7);

        let attempts = 0;

        while(results.length < vocabCount && attempts < 200) {

            attempts++;

            if(vocabList.length === 0) break;

            const type = Math.floor(Math.random()*2);

            const idx = (Math.floor(Math.random()*vocabList.length) + versionOffset) % vocabList.length;

            const word = vocabList[idx];

            if(!word) continue;

            

            let q, opts, ans, exp;

            if(type === 0) {

                q = `"${word}"的中文意思是？`;

                ans = trans[word];

                if(!ans) continue;

                const allTrans = Object.values(trans);

                const wrong = shuffleArray(allTrans.filter(t => t !== ans)).slice(0,3);

                opts = [ans, ...wrong];

                exp = `${word}的意思是"${ans}"，请熟记课本单词表。`;

            } else {

                ans = word;

                const cn = trans[word];

                if(!cn) continue;

                q = `"${cn}"的英文单词是？`;

                const wrong = shuffleArray(vocabList.filter(w => w !== word)).slice(0,3);

                opts = [ans, ...wrong];

                exp = `"${cn}"对应的英文是"${word}"，注意拼写。`;

            }

            

            const uniqueOpts = [...new Set(opts)];

            if(uniqueOpts.length >= 4) {

                const fp = `eng_${word}_${type}_${version}`;

                if(!used.has(fp)) {

                    used.add(fp);

                    const shuffled = shuffleOptions(uniqueOpts.slice(0,4), 0);

                    results.push({

                        id: `E${grade}${term}_${version}_${results.length}`,

                        type: 'english',

                        grade, term,

                        question: q,

                        options: shuffled.options,

                        correctIndex: shuffled.correctIndex,

                        explanation: exp,

                        difficulty: grade <= 2 ? 1 : grade <= 4 ? 2 : 3

                    });

                }

            }

        }

        

        if(grammar && grade >= 3) {

            const gramCount = count - results.length;

            attempts = 0;

            while(results.length < count && attempts < 200) {

                attempts++;

                const gIdx = (Math.floor(Math.random()*grammar.length) + versionOffset) % grammar.length;

                const tmpl = grammar[gIdx];

                const fp = `gram_${tmpl.q.substring(0,15)}_${version}`;

                if(!used.has(fp)) {

                    used.add(fp);

                    const shuffled = shuffleOptions(tmpl.opts, tmpl.ans);

                    results.push({

                        id: `E${grade}${term}_${version}_${results.length}`,

                        type: 'english',

                        grade, term,

                        question: tmpl.q,

                        options: shuffled.options,

                        correctIndex: shuffled.correctIndex,

                        explanation: tmpl.e,

                        difficulty: grade <= 4 ? 2 : 3

                    });

                }

            }

        }

        

        while(results.length < count) {

            const fallbackWord = vocabList[(results.length + versionOffset) % vocabList.length] || 'apple';

            const fallbackAns = trans[fallbackWord] || '苹果';

            const allTrans = Object.values(trans);

            const wrong = shuffleArray(allTrans.filter(t => t !== fallbackAns)).slice(0,3);

            const opts = [fallbackAns, ...wrong];

            const shuffled = shuffleOptions([...new Set(opts)].slice(0,4), 0);

            results.push({

                id: `E${grade}${term}_${version}_${results.length}`,

                type: 'english',

                grade, term,

                question: `"${fallbackWord}"的中文意思是？`,

                options: shuffled.options,

                correctIndex: shuffled.correctIndex,

                explanation: `${fallbackWord}的意思是"${fallbackAns}"。`,

                difficulty: 1

            });

        }

        

        return results.slice(0, count);

    }

};

            {q:'我国最高的山峰是？',a:'珠穆朗玛峰',opts:['珠穆朗玛峰','乔戈里峰','贡嘎山','梅里雪山'],e:'珠穆朗玛峰海拔8848.86米，是世界最高峰，位于中国与尼泊尔边境的喜马拉雅山脉。'},

            {q:'互联网的前身ARPANET诞生于哪年？',a:'1969年',opts:['1969年','1989年','1999年','2009年'],e:'ARPANET诞生于1969年，是美国国防部高级研究计划局建立的分组交换网，是互联网的雏形。'},

            {q:'下列哪种能源来自地球内部？',a:'地热能',opts:['地热能','风能','潮汐能','水能'],e:'地热能来自地球内部放射性元素衰变产生的热能。风能来自太阳辐射造成的温差，潮汐能来自月球引力，水能来自太阳蒸发降水。'}

        ]

    },

 

    generate(grade, term, count, version='A') {

        const key = `${grade}_${term}`;

        let pool = this.data[key] || [];

        if(pool.length < count) {

            const fallback = this.data[`${Math.min(grade+1,6)}_${term}`] || this.data[`${grade}_${term===1?2:1}`] || [];

            pool = [...pool, ...fallback];

        }

        

        const results = [];

        const used = new Set();

        const shuffled = shuffleArray(pool);

        const versionOffset = version === 'B' ? 3 : 0;

        

        for(let i=0; i<shuffled.length; i++) {

            if(results.length >= count) break;

            const item = shuffled[(i + versionOffset) % shuffled.length];

            const fp = `common_${item.q.substring(0,10)}_${version}`;

            if(!used.has(fp)) {

                used.add(fp);

                const correctIdx = item.opts.indexOf(item.a);

                const shuffledOpts = shuffleOptions(item.opts, correctIdx >= 0 ? correctIdx : 0);

                results.push({

                    id: `K${grade}${term}_${version}_${results.length}`,

                    type: 'common',

                    grade, term,

                    question: item.q,

                    options: shuffledOpts.options,

                    correctIndex: shuffledOpts.correctIndex,

                    explanation: item.e,

                    difficulty: grade <= 2 ? 1 : grade <= 4 ? 2 : 3

                });

            }

        }

        

        while(results.length < count) {

            results.push({

                id: `K${grade}${term}_${version}_${results.length}`,

                type: 'common',

                grade, term,

                question: '这是一道常识题，请选择正确答案。',

                options: ['A','B','C','D'],

                correctIndex: 0,

                explanation: '常识题需要平时多积累。',

                difficulty: 1

            });

        }

        

        return results.slice(0, count);

    }

};

 

/* ==================== 第六卷：主应用逻辑 ==================== */

const App = {

    state: {

        page: 'home',

        grade: 3,

        term: 1,

        subject: 'mix',

        paper: 'A',

        count: 20,

        questions: [],

        currentIndex: 0,

        answers: {},

        confirmed: {},

        startTime: 0,

        endTime: 0,

        result: null,

        history: [],

        wrongBook: []

    },

    

    init() {

        this.loadStorage();

        this.render();

    },

    

    loadStorage() {

        try {

            this.state.history = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CONFIG.STORAGE_PREFIX+'history')||'[]');

            this.state.wrongBook = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CONFIG.STORAGE_PREFIX+'wrong')||'[]');

        } catch(e) { console.error(e); }

    },

    

    saveStorage() {

        try {

            localStorage.setItem(CONFIG.STORAGE_PREFIX+'history', JSON.stringify(this.state.history));

            localStorage.setItem(CONFIG.STORAGE_PREFIX+'wrong', JSON.stringify(this.state.wrongBook));

        } catch(e) { console.error(e); }

    },

    

    generateQuestions() {

        const {grade, term, subject, count, paper} = this.state;

        let questions = [];

        const counts = {};

        

        if(subject === 'mix') {

            counts.math = Math.round(count * 0.4);

            counts.chinese = Math.round(count * 0.3);

            counts.english = Math.round(count * 0.2);

            counts.common = count - counts.math - counts.chinese - counts.english;

        } else {

            counts[subject] = count;

        }

        

        if(counts.math) questions = [...questions, ...MathEngine.generate(grade, term, counts.math, paper)];

        if(counts.chinese) questions = [...questions, ...ChineseEngine.generate(grade, term, counts.chinese, paper)];

        if(counts.english) questions = [...questions, ...EnglishEngine.generate(grade, term, counts.english, paper)];

        if(counts.common) questions = [...questions, ...CommonEngine.generate(grade, term, counts.common, paper)];

        

        questions = shuffleArray(questions).slice(0, count);

        questions.forEach((q, i) => { q._index = i; });

        

        this.state.questions = questions;

        this.state.currentIndex = 0;

        this.state.answers = {};

        this.state.confirmed = {};

        this.state.startTime = Date.now();

        this.state.endTime = 0;

        this.state.result = null;

    },

    

    render() {

        const app = document.getElementById('app');

        app.innerHTML = '';

        switch(this.state.page) {

            case 'home': this.renderHome(app); break;

            case 'quiz': this.renderQuiz(app); break;

            case 'result': this.renderResult(app); break;

            case 'review': this.renderReview(app); break;

            case 'history': this.renderHistory(app); break;

            case 'settings': this.renderSettings(app); break;

        }

    },

    

    renderHome(container) {

        const {grade, term, subject, count, paper} = this.state;

        const subjectOpts = CONFIG.SUBJECTS.map(s =>

            `<button class="btn ${subject===s.id?'btn-primary':''}" onclick="App.setSubject('${s.id}')" style="margin:5px">${s.name}</button>`

        ).join('');

        

        container.innerHTML = `

            <div class="container">

                <h1>�� 小学教育测评系统 V${CONFIG.VERSION}</h1>

                <div class="card">

                    <h2>�� 选择年级</h2>

                    <div class="grid-3">

                        ${CONFIG.GRADES.map(g => `<button class="btn ${grade===g?'btn-primary':''}" onclick="App.setGrade(${g})">${g}年级</button>`).join('')}

                    </div>

                </div>

                <div class="card">

                    <h2>�� 选择学期</h2>

                    <div class="grid-2">

                        ${CONFIG.TERMS.map(t => `<button class="btn ${term===t?'btn-primary':''}" onclick="App.setTerm(${t})">${t===1?'上学期':'下学期'}</button>`).join('')}

                    </div>

                </div>

                <div class="card">

                    <h2>�� 选择科目</h2>

                    <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center">

                        ${subjectOpts}

                    </div>

                </div>

                <div class="card">

                    <h2>�� 分卷选择 <span class="paper-badge">${paper}卷</span></h2>

                    <div class="grid-2">

                        ${CONFIG.PAPERS.map(p => `<button class="btn ${paper===p?'btn-primary':''}" onclick="App.setPaper('${p}')">${p}卷（${p==='A'?'标准卷':'平行卷'}）</button>`).join('')}

                    </div>

                    <div class="info-box" style="margin-top:10px">

                        A卷与B卷知识点相同，题目不同，适合同桌互测或二次练习。

                    </div>

                </div>

                <div class="card">

                    <h2>�� 题目数量</h2>

                    <div class="grid-4">

                        ${CONFIG.COUNTS.map(c => `<button class="btn ${count===c?'btn-primary':''}" onclick="App.setCount(${c})">${c}题</button>`).join('')}

                    </div>

                </div>

                <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="App.startQuiz()" style="margin-top:20px">�� 开始测评</button>

                <div class="grid-2" style="margin-top:10px">

                    <button class="btn btn-info" onclick="App.showHistory()">�� 历史记录</button>

                    <button class="btn btn-warning" onclick="App.showSettings()">⚙️ 设置</button>

                </div>

            </div>

        `;

    },

    

    renderQuiz(container) {

        const {questions, currentIndex, answers, confirmed, startTime, paper} = this.state;

        const q = questions[currentIndex];

        const total = questions.length;

        const hasAnswer = answers[currentIndex] !== undefined;

        const isConfirmed = confirmed[currentIndex];

        

        const answeredCount = Object.keys(answers).length;

        const progress = ((currentIndex + 1) / total * 100).toFixed(0);

        const elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now() - startTime)/1000);

        const mins = Math.floor(elapsed/60);

        const secs = elapsed%60;

        const timeStr = `${mins}:${secs.toString().padStart(2,'0')}`;

        

        let optionsHtml = '';

        q.options.forEach((opt, idx) => {

            let cls = 'btn btn-option';

            let label = String.fromCharCode(65 + idx);

            

            if(isConfirmed) {

                if(idx === q.correctIndex) {

                    cls += ' correct';

                    label = '✓';

                } else if(answers[currentIndex] === idx && idx !== q.correctIndex) {

                    cls += ' wrong';

                    label = '✕';

                } else {

                    cls += ' disabled';

                }

            } else if(answers[currentIndex] === idx) {

                cls += ' selected';

            }

            

            optionsHtml += `<button class="${cls}" data-label="${label}" onclick="App.selectOption(${idx})" ${isConfirmed?'disabled':''}>${opt}</button>`;

        });

        

        let expHtml = '';

        if(isConfirmed) {

            const isCorrect = answers[currentIndex] === q.correctIndex;

            expHtml = `

                <div class="explanation show" style="margin-top:16px">

                    <strong>${isCorrect?'✅ 回答正确！':'❌ 回答错误'}</strong><br>

                    ${q.explanation || '暂无解析'}

                </div>

            `;

        }

        

        const subjTag = CONFIG.SUBJECTS.find(s => s.id === q.type);

        const tagHtml = subjTag ? `<span class="tag ${subjTag.tag}">${subjTag.name}</span>` : '';

        const diffHtml = q.difficulty ? `<span class="difficulty-badge diff-${q.difficulty===1?'easy':q.difficulty===2?'medium':'hard'}">${q.difficulty===1?'简单':q.difficulty===2?'中等':'困难'}</span>` : '';

        

        container.innerHTML = `

            <div class="container">

                <div class="card">

                    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px">

                        <span>${tagHtml}${diffHtml}<span class="paper-badge">${paper}卷</span></span>

                        <span style="color:var(--text-secondary);font-size:14px">${currentIndex+1}/${total} · ⏱️${timeStr}</span>

                    </div>

                    <div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-fill" style="width:${progress}%"></div></div>

                    <div style="font-size:var(--font-lg);font-weight:600;margin:20px 0;line-height:1.6">${q.question}</div>

                    <div>${optionsHtml}</div>

                    ${expHtml}

                </div>

                <div class="grid-3" style="margin-top:16px">

                    <button class="btn" onclick="App.prevQuestion()" ${currentIndex===0?'disabled':''}>⬅️ 上一题</button>

                    <button class="btn ${hasAnswer&&!isConfirmed?'btn-success':'btn-warning'}" onclick="App.confirmOrNext()" ${!hasAnswer?'disabled':''}>

                        ${isConfirmed ? (currentIndex === total-1 ? '✅ 提交' : '➡️ 下一题') : '✓ 确认答案'}

                    </button>

                    <button class="btn" onclick="App.nextQuestion()" ${currentIndex===total-1?'disabled':''}>➡️ 下一题</button>

                </div>

                <div style="text-align:center;margin-top:12px;color:var(--text-secondary);font-size:14px">

                    已答 ${answeredCount}/${total} 题 · ${paper}卷

                </div>

                <button class="btn" onclick="App.submitQuiz()" style="margin-top:20px;background:var(--error);color:white;border-color:var(--error)">�� 结束并提交</button>

            </div>

        `;

    },

    

    renderResult(container) {

        const {result, questions, paper} = this.state;

        if(!result) return;

        

        const {score, correct, wrong, timeUsed, wrongQuestions} = result;

        const percentage = Math.round(score);

        const isPass = percentage >= 60;

        const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * 70;

        const offset = circumference - (percentage / 100) * circumference;

        

        const achievement = percentage === 100 ? '�� 满分状元' :

                           percentage >= 90 ? '�� 学霸之星' :

                           percentage >= 80 ? '�� 优秀学员' :

                           percentage >= 60 ? '�� 及格通过' : '�� 继续加油';

        

        container.innerHTML = `

            <div class="container">

                <h1>�� ${paper}卷 测评完成！</h1>

                <div class="card" style="text-align:center">

                    <div class="result-ring">

                        <svg width="160" height="160" style="transform:rotate(-90deg)">

                            <circle class="ring-bg" cx="80" cy="80" r="70"/>

                            <circle class="ring-fill" cx="80" cy="80" r="70"

                                stroke-dasharray="${circumference}"

                                stroke-dashoffset="${offset}"/>

                        </svg>

                        <div class="ring-text">

                            <div class="ring-score">${percentage}</div>

                            <div style="font-size:14px;color:var(--text-secondary)">分</div>

                        </div>

                    </div>

                    <div style="margin:12px 0">

                        <span class="achievement">${achievement}</span>

                        <span class="paper-badge">${paper}卷</span>

                    </div>

                    <div class="stat-row">

                        <div class="stat-item correct"><span class="num">${correct}</span><span>正确</span></div>

                        <div class="stat-item wrong"><span class="num">${wrong}</span><span>错误</span></div>

                        <div class="stat-item"><span class="num">${timeUsed}</span><span>用时(秒)</span></div>

                    </div>

                    <div style="font-size:18px;margin:16px 0;color:${isPass? 'var(--success)':'var(--error)'};font-weight:700">

                        ${isPass ? '�� 恭喜通过！' : '别气馁，再试一次！'}

                    </div>

                    ${wrongQuestions.length > 0 ? `

                        <button class="btn btn-warning" onclick="App.showReview()">�� 查看错题(${wrongQuestions.length})</button>

                    ` : ''}

                </div>

                <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="App.goHome()">�� 返回首页</button>

                <div class="grid-2" style="margin-top:10px">

                    <button class="btn btn-info" onclick="App.startQuiz()">�� 再做${paper}卷</button>

                    <button class="btn btn-success" onclick="App.switchPaper()">�� 换做${paper==='A'?'B':'A'}卷</button>

                </div>

            </div>

        `;

    },

    

    renderReview(container) {

        const {wrongBook} = this.state;

        if(wrongBook.length === 0) {

            container.innerHTML = `

                <div class="container">

                    <h1>�� 错题本</h1>

                    <div class="card" style="text-align:center;padding:40px">

                        <div style="font-size:48px;margin-bottom:16px">��</div>

                        <div style="font-size:18px;color:var(--text-secondary)">暂无错题，继续保持！</div>

                    </div>

                    <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="App.goHome()">�� 返回首页</button>

                </div>

            `;

            return;

        }

        

        let itemsHtml = '';

        wrongBook.slice(-50).reverse().forEach((item) => {

            itemsHtml += `

                <div class="wrong-item">

                    <div style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px">

                        <span class="topic-tag">${item.subjectName || '综合'}</span>

                        <span class="paper-badge">${item.paper || 'A'}</span>

                        ${item.question}

                    </div>

                    <div style="color:var(--error);margin-bottom:4px">你的答案：${item.yourAnswer || '未答'}</div>

                    <div style="color:var(--success);margin-bottom:4px">正确答案：${item.correctAnswer}</div>

                    <div class="q-exp">${item.explanation || '暂无解析'}</div>

                </div>

            `;

        });

        

        container.innerHTML = `

            <div class="container">

                <h1>�� 错题本 (${wrongBook.length}道)</h1>

                <div class="wrong-list">${itemsHtml}</div>

                <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="App.goHome()">�� 返回首页</button>

                <button class="btn btn-warning" onclick="App.clearWrongBook()">��️ 清空错题本</button>

            </div>

        `;

    },

    

    renderHistory(container) {

        const {history} = this.state;

        if(history.length === 0) {

            container.innerHTML = `

                <div class="container">

                    <h1>�� 历史记录</h1>

                    <div class="card" style="text-align:center;padding:40px">

                        <div style="font-size:48px;margin-bottom:16px">��</div>

                        <div style="font-size:18px;color:var(--text-secondary)">暂无测评记录</div>

                    </div>

                    <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="App.goHome()">�� 返回首页</button>

                </div>

            `;

            return;

        }

        

        let rows = '';

        history.slice().reverse().forEach((h) => {

            const date = new Date(h.time).toLocaleString('zh-CN');

            rows += `

                <div class="card" style="margin:8px 0">

                    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center">

                        <div>

                            <div style="font-weight:700">${h.grade}年级${h.term===1?'上':'下'}学期 · ${h.subjectName} <span class="paper-badge">${h.paper}</span></div>

                            <div style="font-size:14px;color:var(--text-secondary);margin-top:4px">${date} · ${h.count}题</div>

                        </div>

                        <div style="text-align:right">

                            <div style="font-size:28px;font-weight:800;color:${h.score>=60?'var(--success)':'var(--error)'}">${h.score}分</div>

                            <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text-secondary)">${h.correct}对${h.wrong}错 · ${h.timeUsed}秒</div>

                        </div>

                    </div>

                </div>

            `;

        });

        

        container.innerHTML = `

            <div class="container">

                <h1>�� 历史记录</h1>

                ${rows}

                <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="App.goHome()">�� 返回首页</button>

                <button class="btn btn-warning" onclick="App.clearHistory()">��️ 清空记录</button>

            </div>

        `;

    },

    

    renderSettings(container) {

        container.innerHTML = `

            <div class="container">

                <h1>⚙️ 设置</h1>

                <div class="card">

                    <h2>数据管理</h2>

                    <button class="btn btn-warning" onclick="App.clearHistory()">��️ 清空历史记录</button>

                    <button class="btn btn-warning" onclick="App.clearWrongBook()">��️ 清空错题本</button>

                    <button class="btn" onclick="App.clearAll()" style="background:var(--error);color:white;border-color:var(--error);margin-top:10px">⚠️ 清空所有数据</button>

                </div>

                <div class="card">

                    <h2>关于</h2>

                    <div class="info-box">

                        <div>小学教育测评系统 V${CONFIG.VERSION} 分卷版</div>

                        <div style="margin-top:8px">支持年级：1-6年级 · A/B双卷</div>

                        <div>支持科目：数学、语文、英语、常识、综合</div>

                        <div style="margin-top:8px">题目根据年级教材知识点智能生成，A/B卷题目不同但难度一致</div>

                    </div>

                </div>

                <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="App.goHome()">�� 返回首页</button>

            </div>

        `;

    },

    

    setGrade(g) { this.state.grade = g; this.render(); },

    setTerm(t) { this.state.term = t; this.render(); },

    setSubject(s) { this.state.subject = s; this.render(); },

    setCount(c) { this.state.count = c; this.render(); },

    setPaper(p) { this.state.paper = p; this.render(); },

    

    startQuiz() {

        this.generateQuestions();

        this.state.page = 'quiz';

        this.render();

        showToast(`${this.state.paper}卷测评开始，加油！`);

    },

    

    switchPaper() {

        this.state.paper = this.state.paper === 'A' ? 'B' : 'A';

        this.startQuiz();

    },

    

    selectOption(idx) {

        if(this.state.confirmed[this.state.currentIndex]) return;

        this.state.answers[this.state.currentIndex] = idx;

        this.render();

    },

    

    confirmOrNext() {

        const {currentIndex, questions, answers, confirmed} = this.state;

        if(!confirmed[currentIndex]) {

            this.state.confirmed[currentIndex] = true;

            this.render();

        } else {

            if(currentIndex === questions.length - 1) {

                this.submitQuiz();

            } else {

                this.state.currentIndex++;

                this.render();

            }

        }

    },

    

    prevQuestion() {

        if(this.state.currentIndex > 0) {

            this.state.currentIndex--;

            this.render();

        }

    },

    

    nextQuestion() {

        if(this.state.currentIndex < this.state.questions.length - 1) {

            this.state.currentIndex++;

            this.render();

        }

    },

    

    submitQuiz() {

        const {questions, answers, startTime, count, grade, term, subject, paper} = this.state;

        this.state.endTime = Date.now();

        const timeUsed = Math.floor((this.state.endTime - startTime) / 1000);

        

        let correct = 0, wrong = 0;

        const wrongQuestions = [];

        

        questions.forEach((q, idx) => {

            const userAns = answers[idx];

            const isCorrect = userAns === q.correctIndex;

            if(isCorrect) {

                correct++;

            } else {

                wrong++;

                const record = {

                    id: q.id,

                    subject: q.type,

                    subjectName: CONFIG.SUBJECTS.find(s=>s.id===q.type)?.name || '综合',

                    paper,

                    grade, term,

                    question: q.question,

                    yourAnswer: userAns !== undefined ? q.options[userAns] : '未作答',

                    correctAnswer: q.options[q.correctIndex],

                    explanation: q.explanation,

                    time: Date.now()

                };

                wrongQuestions.push(record);

                if(!this.state.wrongBook.find(w => w.id === q.id && w.question === q.question)) {

                    this.state.wrongBook.push(record);

                }

            }

        });

        

        const score = Math.round((correct / questions.length) * 100);

        const result = {score, correct, wrong, timeUsed, wrongQuestions, total: questions.length};

        this.state.result = result;

        

        const historyItem = {

            time: Date.now(),

            grade, term, count, paper,

            subject: subject,

            subjectName: CONFIG.SUBJECTS.find(s=>s.id===subject)?.name || '综合',

            score, correct, wrong, timeUsed

        };

        this.state.history.push(historyItem);

        if(this.state.history.length > 50) this.state.history.shift();

        

        this.saveStorage();

        this.state.page = 'result';

        this.render();

        showToast(`${paper}卷测评完成！得分：${score}分`);

    },

    

    showReview() {

        this.state.page = 'review';

        this.render();

    },

    

    showHistory() {

        this.state.page = 'history';

        this.render();

    },

    

    showSettings() {

        this.state.page = 'settings';

        this.render();

    },

    

    goHome() {

        this.state.page = 'home';

        this.state.questions = [];

        this.state.answers = {};

        this.state.confirmed = {};

        this.state.result = null;

        this.render();

    },

    

    clearWrongBook() {

        if(confirm('确定要清空错题本吗？')) {

            this.state.wrongBook = [];

            this.saveStorage();

            this.render();

            showToast('错题本已清空');

        }

    },

    

    clearHistory() {

        if(confirm('确定要清空历史记录吗？')) {

            this.state.history = [];

            this.saveStorage();

            this.render();

            showToast('历史记录已清空');

        }

    },

    

    clearAll() {

        if(confirm('确定要清空所有数据吗？此操作不可恢复！')) {

            this.state.history = [];

            this.state.wrongBook = [];

            localStorage.removeItem(CONFIG.STORAGE_PREFIX+'history');

            localStorage.removeItem(CONFIG.STORAGE_PREFIX+'wrong');

            this.render();

            showToast('所有数据已清空');

        }

    }

};

 

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {

    App.init();

});

</script>

</body>

</html>
